nightly-bot: nightly-eval alert: run redwood-instruct-3b-v2 @quant-q6_k on job 2024-03-15_06_23 produced a large repetition/tok-storm on prompt set customer-support-faq. spike in tokens/sec and toxicity score. attaching sample below.

maya_reinke: whoa, saw that in the dashboard. seq length skyrocketed to 120k for one sample. saving raw generation now.

eva_kim: can you paste the sample? looks like a repeat loop rather than a hallucination. could be KV wrap or decoding loop w/ quant kernel mismatch. :eyes:

maya_reinke: paste: ```
User: My order was charged twice, what do I do?
Model: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry... (repeats)
-- repeated token pattern: 'I'm sorry,' repeated 10k times --
End.
```

julian_chan: any config diff from last good nightly? model sha / weights / kernel revision?

maya_reinke: same model sha as last week (sha: a1b2c3d), quant profile changed: switched from q8_dynamic to q6_k for perf. runtime kernel set: fast-attn-v2 + qk4-opt enabled. eval command: `./run_eval --model redwood-instruct-3b-v2 --quant q6_k --batch 8 --seed 42 --job 2024-03-15_06_23`

ops-bot: noticed correlated falls: eu-west-1 dedicated pool had 3 incidents around 06:20 UTC with oom fallback -> routed to fallback model variant. might be related to autoscaler thrash.

eva_kim: hypothesis: quant kernel reduced numeric headroom leading to KV-cache index misalignment when using fast-attn-v2 variant. That can create an effective loop because previous keys/values get duplicated or misread. low sample entropy + repeating token pattern supports this.

julian_chan: can you create a minimal repro that hits the loop deterministically? we should bisect on quant kernels (q6_k vs q8_dyn) and flash-attn vs default. I'll open an ENG-RUNTIME issue.

maya_reinke: quick repro snippet I used (python):
```python
# minimal repro harness
from redwood_eval import Client
client = Client(model="redwood-instruct-3b-v2", quant="q6_k", kernel="fast-attn-v2")
prompt = open('customer-support-faq/issue_142.txt').read()
res = client.generate(prompt, max_tokens=20000, temperature=0.0, stop=None)
print(res.text[:1000])
```

maya_reinke: running this with seed=42 reproduces the storm ~80% on our node with kernel fast-attn-v2. switching to q8_dyn or kernel=flash-attn-v1 avoids the loop.

eva_kim: perfect, can you stash logs and KV dumps to the ticket? key things: raw logits, topk traces, and KV lengths at each step. also run with `--dump-kv=positions` so we can check wraparound.

maya_reinke: uploading artifacts to the ENG-RUNTIME triage ticket now (job 2024-03-15_06_23). linked.

julian_chan: assigning to @eva_kim and @maya_reinke. action items: 1) bisect quant kernel commits, 2) run repro across kernels & quant modes, 3) add guards in runtime to detect runaway repetition (early stop if token entropy < threshold for N steps), 4) add nightly alert for token-rate spikes.

ops-bot: FYI: temporarily rate-limited the customer-support-faq nightly until triage completes to avoid noisy billing.

maya_reinke: noted. I will also pin the nightly to q8_dyn for now and rerun the full suite. thanks all. :thumbsup:
